title: Text to image on fal.ai
description: Draws a picture from a prompt with Z-Image Turbo, which runs on fal.ai, not on this machine: about $0.005 a picture at 1024 by 1024. Needs a fal.ai key (Settings > Providers > add fal.ai); the prompt goes to fal.ai.

app.title: Text to image on fal.ai
app.summary: Draw a picture on fal.ai, about $0.005.
